The Polokwane branch is listed on Outdoor Warehouse's own official store locator, confirming it as part of the chain's national network of outdoor-equipment stores across South Africa. The store trades from The Farmyard Trading Post on School Road in Bendor, Polokwane.

It is a useful stop for campers, hikers, four-wheel-drive enthusiasts and other outdoor-minded shoppers in and around the city who are fitting out a trip, upgrading their gear or replacing worn equipment before heading into the bush.

Protea Chemicals' Polokwane branch is based in Futura, Polokwane, forming part of the company's wider distribution network across South Africa. Sizabantu Piping Systems' Limpopo Division manufactures and distributes plastic piping solutions used in civil construction, irrigation and industrial applications, including pressure pipe, sewer and drainage systems and related fittings. The division's own official information states that it launched in Laboria, Polokwane, in September 2003 and has since grown into the company's largest plastic-pipe distribution operation in Limpopo.

The division supplies civil-construction contractors, irrigation installers and industrial operators across the province who need reliable plastic piping for water, sewer and drainage networks on building sites, farms and industrial premises. It forms part of Sizabantu's wider national network of piping-systems divisions.

Based in Laboria, Polokwane, the division is a long-standing supplier for the region's construction, agricultural and industrial sectors, drawing on more than two decades of local trading history to serve customers across Limpopo.

Tekkie Town is a South African footwear retailer specialising in branded and casual sports shoes, sneakers and everyday footwear for men, women and children. Its Polokwane branch, trading from Mall of the North in Bendor, is confirmed both on the mall's own official store directory and independently on Tekkie Town's own current store locator, which lists it among the chain's branches serving the wider Polokwane area.

The store serves shoppers across Polokwane looking for name-brand sports and casual footwear at a mall location, drawing on Tekkie Town's position within the Pepkor group of retail brands to offer a wide range of styles and sizes.

Shoppers can find the store at Shop L18 in Mall of the North, a convenient stop for anyone doing a footwear shop alongside the centre's other stores.

The Irish House is a heritage building in Polokwane Central that now houses the Polokwane Museum, displaying exhibits on the history and culture of Limpopo's diverse peoples. The building itself dates back to 1886, was rebuilt after a fire in 1906, and was converted into a museum in the 1980s, a history confirmed independently through municipal heritage information and South African History Online.

Visitors can see Iron Age and Stone Age artefacts alongside displays on the origins and traditions of the region's communities, making it a point of reference for understanding Polokwane's past. It serves tourists, residents and anyone with an interest in local history and heritage.

Standing at the corner of Thabo Mbeki Street and Market Street in Polokwane Central, the museum is an easy stop for visitors exploring the city centre's historic buildings and civic landmarks.

items.description:
Unjani Clinic Seshego is a primary healthcare clinic offering everyday medical services to the local community, operating as part of the Unjani network of nurse-led clinics found across South Africa. The clinic's own official listing confirms that this branch opened on 22 May 2018, giving it several years of continuous service to patients in the area.

Unjani clinics are built around affordable, accessible primary care, typically covering consultations, basic treatment and referrals for conditions that would otherwise send patients to busier public facilities. This branch serves residents of Seshego, Moletjie and the surrounding parts of Polokwane who need convenient access to primary healthcare close to home.

The clinic is located at Mohlakaneng Shopping Centre on Polokwane Drive, directly across from the Seshego Circle Centre, making it an easily reached option for Seshego-area patients seeking routine healthcare.

Virgin Active Thornhill is a gym club in Thornhill, Bendor, Polokwane, with a heated lap pool, steam room, functional training area, indoor cycling and rowing studios, and Wattbikes. Group classes include aqua, cycle, yoga and boxing, and members can book a tour or join online.

The club has a Club-V childcare space, where children from six weeks to seven years are cared for in an access-controlled area while parents train. It also offers massage therapists, physiotherapists and swim coaches, and free WiFi and an accessible changeroom. Membership plans are priced by age group, with full access to the Thornhill club and options for access to a selected group of clubs. The club is suited to families and members who want a full gym, swim and class schedule in one place.

Ya-Rena Construction is a civil engineering and structural concrete construction company undertaking reservoirs, dams, bridges, mining infrastructure, water and wastewater treatment plants, general building works, turnkey projects and aggregate crushing. The company's own official information states that it was registered in 1995 and has completed major infrastructure projects, including reservoirs built for Polokwane Municipality.

The company currently states a 51.8% black-ownership stake and Level 3 B-BBEE contributor status, positioning it to work with government departments, municipalities, mining companies, private property developers and other contractors on civil and structural projects across the region. Its project scope spans everything from bulk water infrastructure to mining-related construction work.

Ya-Rena Construction is based in Ladanna, Polokwane, serving clients across Limpopo who need an established contractor for large-scale civil engineering and concrete construction work.

Jorene's Guest House offers overnight guest accommodation in Hospital Park, Polokwane, with a mix of room types shown on its accommodation-booking listing, including queen rooms with an en-suite bath and shower, double rooms, triple rooms and more basic budget rooms. Together, the property's rooms can sleep up to eighteen guests.

Guests can check in from 14:00 and check out by 10:00, a straightforward arrangement suited to travellers passing through Polokwane for a night or two, whether for business, a family visit or an event in the city. Past guests have rated the property's location in Hospital Park favourably for being convenient to reach.

The guest house is based on Hoog Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane, within reach of the city centre, making it a practical base for short stays in the city.

Kuramed Pharmacy is a retail pharmacy offering dispensing services, over-the-counter medicines and everyday healthcare products from Turfloop Plaza in Mankweng. The pharmacy's trading identity is confirmed on an official pharmacy-group store listing, which records it within The Local Choice network of community pharmacies operating across South Africa.

The pharmacy serves patients and local customers who need prescription medicines, pharmacy advice and healthcare products close to home, including students, staff and residents connected to the nearby University of Limpopo campus and the wider Mankweng area. As part of a pharmacy network rather than a standalone operator, it draws on group-level buying and dispensing systems while still serving the immediate community directly.

The pharmacy trades from Shop F2 in Turfloop Plaza on University Road, Mankweng, a convenient stop for anyone collecting medication or healthcare essentials in the area.

Ledimor Guesthouse is a four-star rated guesthouse next to Savannah Mall and McDonald's, about 2 km from the city centre and 7 km from the airport. It offers hospitality in the South African style, aimed at families and business travellers.

Rooms have white percale linen and towels, a flat-screen TV with DVD player and DStv, plug-in internet access, coffee, tea and biscuits, air conditioning, a safe, a bar fridge and a hair dryer. The guesthouse offers airport transfers, laundry service, a dining room where breakfast, lunch or dinner can be added, and a swimming pool with a braai area.

For meetings, it has a private room, a modern boardroom and conference facilities with in-house catering. The guesthouse is in the heart of Polokwane and is easy to reach from Peter Mokaba Stadium, which the guesthouse lists as about 5 km away.

Lindekroon Guest House is a bed-and-breakfast guest house offering family rooms with private bathrooms, air conditioning and garden views, along with free Wi-Fi and free on-site parking. A cooked breakfast is included for guests, and an airport shuttle service is available for those flying in and out of Polokwane.

Current guest reviews on a major booking platform show the property with more than ninety-five reviews and a rating around 8.8 out of 10, reflecting consistently positive guest experiences. The guest house suits business travellers, couples and families visiting Polokwane who want a comfortable, well-reviewed base with breakfast and transport support included.

Lindekroon Guest House is located on Voortrekker Street in Hospital Park, Polokwane, a convenient option for visitors who need easy access to the city centre during their stay.

Masana Cafe is an award-winning restaurant at Masana Hotel in Moregloed, serving traditional Limpopo cuisine through both an a la carte menu and a buffet service. The cafe's own hotel website describes it as offering breakfast and dinner service, giving guests and visiting diners a choice of dining styles built around local dishes.

Beyond everyday dining, the cafe also provides catering and venue facilities for weddings, corporate functions and private celebrations, making it a venue option for hosts planning events in the Polokwane area as well as a restaurant for hotel guests and local diners wanting a sit-down meal.

Masana Cafe is based at 99 Johnson Street in Moregloed, Polokwane, serving hotel guests, local diners and anyone attending a function or celebration hosted at the venue.

This Old Mutual branch at Mall of the North operates as the Old Mutual Finance branch for the Polokwane area, a classification confirmed through an independent current business listing alongside the mall's own store directory. The branch offers financial planning, insurance and investment-related products and services for individual customers.

Rather than serving corporate or institutional clients, this branch focuses on personal-finance customers in and around Polokwane who want in-person financial planning, insurance cover or investment advice from a nationally established financial services group. The branch also maintains its own dedicated social media page for local customers, separate from Old Mutual's general national presence.

The branch trades from Shop L40 in Mall of the North, Bendor, giving Polokwane shoppers and residents a mall-based point of contact for their personal financial services needs.

items.description:
Royal Baeng Private Residence, also listed as Royal Baeng Country Estate, is a guesthouse and private-event venue set on a garden property in Dalmada. Alongside guest rooms that are air-conditioned and en-suite, the estate runs its own restaurant and a sky bar, and hires out a sports field for outdoor entertainment plus a dedicated meeting room for smaller gatherings. The property has built up a substantial base of guest reviews, reflecting steady use by both overnight visitors and clients booking the venue for private functions, corporate meetings or outdoor events.

A terrace, free private parking, free WiFi and a 24-hour front desk round out the offering for those staying over. Royal Baeng Private Residence is located at 88 Second Street in Dalmada, on the outskirts of Polokwane, and suits travellers wanting guesthouse accommodation as well as groups looking to hire a function space, meeting room or outdoor venue in one place.

Sirina Thai Spa is a Thai massage and wellness spa on Grobler Street in Polokwane Central, one of the group's spas across South Africa trained in traditional Thai techniques. The treatment menu includes clothed, mat-based traditional Thai massage, hot stone massage using heated basalt stones, aromatherapy full-body massage, body scrub treatments, and shorter back, shoulder and neck or head massages for clients short on time.

Beyond individual bookings, the spa takes group bookings and gift vouchers, and handles corporate and event enquiries for businesses wanting to arrange treatments for staff or guests. It is open seven days a week, from 08:00 to 20:00, at 88 Grobler Street, Polokwane Central, and suits anyone looking for a single treatment, a pampering session with friends, or a wellness booking arranged through an employer.

Stewarts & Lloyds in Superbia is the Polokwane branch dedicated specifically to fluid control, operating separately from the group's Steel & Hardware branch across town in Nirvana. The branch supplies pipes and fittings in steel, HDPE and PVC, along with valves, pumps and irrigation-related products, for customers who need to move, store or manage liquids and gases rather than source structural steel.

That split lets farmers, contractors and industrial buyers deal directly with staff focused on fluid-handling equipment, rather than a general hardware counter. The branch trades from 61 Nelson Mandela Drive in Superbia, Polokwane, and forms part of a supplier network that has operated in South Africa since 1903, serving agricultural, construction, mining and industrial customers who need fluid-control products sourced and delivered locally.

African Roots Guest House offers a variety of accommodation to suit different needs and budgets, from standard rooms and air-conditioned rooms to queen, queen family, twin and king rooms. Each room has its own entrance to the parking, garden or pool area, and the queen rooms include a small lounge.

All rooms have a television with a DStv decoder, a mini-fridge and tea and coffee facilities. A full English breakfast with fresh seasonal fruit, cereal and yoghurt is served, and dinner and lunch packs are available on request. Secure parking has remote access control and CCTV, and the guest house offers free fibre wifi.

The conference venue caters for up to 30 people, with complete conference packages available on request. Inverters and batteries provide backup power during load shedding. The guest house caters for business travellers and other guests in Polokwane's Hospital Park area.

Phuti Funeral Ministry Group is a funeral parlour that describes itself as based in Polokwane, offering funeral plans, funeral cover, tombstone cover and related services. Its funeral services include cremation, and the care it gives the deceased and the bereaved family is described as dignified and thorough.

The group offers burial plans for individuals and families, with claims processed within 48 hours, and group schemes with customised options such as cash back, groceries and airtime. Repatriation and storage services transport families' loved ones, and grave removal, relocation and exhumation are also offered.

Tombstones are available for funerals and unveilings, with a wide range of granite options at affordable prices. The business also accepts cashless payments.

PCS Phatsima, trading as Polokwane Chemical Suppliers, manufactures and supplies cleaning products for households, businesses, government institutions and industrial clients across South Africa. Its products are highly concentrated, and the company describes itself as an award-winning manufacturer that is customer-service oriented.

The company offers daily and weekly delivery schedules, complimentary delivery, and access to more than 500 registered resellers. Its mission focuses on manufacturing systems and processes, continuous improvement, a research and development facility, and community partnerships through its social responsibility programme. The company's website lists ISO certifications covering quality, environmental management, occupational health and safety, and good manufacturing practice for cosmetics.

The business is based in Futura, Polokwane.
